contract_resolution.note: The original audit conclusion is preserved verbatim. It recorded that no reviewed knowledge contract existed on 2026-09-07 at main 90d6238e. A narrow reviewed contract now exists. The evidence findings, the source-semantics gap, and the decision string are unchanged; only this additive status block was appended.
contract_resolution.semantic_authority_note: Established on 2026-09-07 from pinned current Drupal 11.4.5 update-module sources: Release type Insecure -> ProjectRelease::isInsecure() -> installed release assigned UpdateManagerInterface::NOT_SECURE -> documented as the project missing security update(s). No exploitability, CVE, severity, or compromise claim is authorized.
contract_resolution.settlement_note: Settled on 2026-09-07 before merge: the reviewed contract exists but cannot bootstrap confirmed finding semantics from a neutral source observation. Confirmation requires explicit reviewed semantic_authority_refs together with a reviewed revision of the pinned term_semantics contract.

decision_rationale: project evidence and reviewed source evidence prove literal term presence on an exactly matched release row
the pinned snapshot does not define the term, so only presence assertions are available
no reviewed canonical knowledge record declares a machine_finding contract, assertion, finding type, or severity authority
the audited statement is therefore CANDIDATE_ONLY today, blocked by knowledge authority rather than by evidence
